purpose: Official wordmarks identifying score providers, plus Valve as the CS2 event scope; Valve is not credited as a score provider.

pandascore.processing: Official header SVG rasterized at 3x with transparent alpha using PyMuPDF; bundled original white artwork and geometry retained. Night rendering uses the original white art. Day rendering applies theme ink as a monochrome treatment to a copy, preserving the original alpha and geometry with no backing rectangle; this treatment is not claimed as an official dark variant.
pandascore.rights: PandaScore trademark, used to identify the data source. Retains Source: attribution. No open artwork license is asserted.

valve.processing: Original SVG geometry with the official CSS fill #f74843 inlined, rasterized at 3x with transparent alpha using PyMuPDF. Letter cutouts remain transparent. The raster is then reduced proportionally to 654x182 with LANCZOS for the local image-size budget.
valve.rights: Valve trademark, used only to identify the event scope, not the data provider. No open artwork license is asserted.

espn.processing: Official art, transparent alpha bounding-box crop and proportional LANCZOS resize only; SVG rasterized in headless Chrome. Original colors retained.
espn.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the score source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

mlb.processing: Official art, transparent alpha bounding-box crop and proportional LANCZOS resize only; SVG rasterized in headless Chrome. Original colors retained.
mlb.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the score source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

openf1.creator: OpenF1 / br-g
openf1.processing: Official repository wordmark: transparent alpha bounding-box crop and proportional LANCZOS resize only. Night retains the original white/red art. Day applies theme ink to a copy preserving the original alpha and geometry; this monochrome treatment is not claimed as an official variant. No backing rectangle.
openf1.rights: OpenF1 trademark used to identify this data provider; not the Formula 1 league logo. No affiliation or endorsement implied.

csl.processing: SVG drawn 8x by a headless browser on a transparent page, cropped to its ink. The league's emblem and CSL lettering, colours kept.
csl.licence: Non-free logo as used in the English Wikipedia infobox (fair use)
csl.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

draftkings.processing: SVG drawn 8x by a headless browser on a transparent page, cropped to its ink. Crown and stacked DRAFT KINGS lettering, colours kept.
draftkings.licence: Non-free logo as used in the English Wikipedia infobox (fair use)
draftkings.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

bet365.processing: SVG drawn 8x by a headless browser on a transparent page, cropped to its ink. The official green tile with white bet and yellow 365.
bet365.licence: Public domain (Wikimedia Commons, below the threshold of originality)
bet365.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

football_data.processing: Official logo (white lettering, green dash on a near-black ground): the ground cleared by colour distance with un-premultiplied edges, and its two lines set side by side on one line so it reads at caption size. White lettering is inked on light pages at draw time.
football_data.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

api_sports.processing: Official API-SPORTS badge with its white disk cleared; grey lettering and orange accent kept.
api_sports.rights: Trademark of its respective owner, used only to identify the source; no affiliation or endorsement implied.
